address: Audley Redwood, Beggar Bush Lane, Failand, Bristol,BS8 3TG
bio: Nestled in the lush village of Audley Redwood, this off-the-beaten-track gem has one of the best Afternoon Tea deals in the South West, with English charm and contemporary décor in spades.  The cosy yet chic interior at Symonds at Redwood is perfect for an afternoon treat and is kitted out with leather chairs, mismatched furniture and tasteful artwork for a sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
